why: Confirmed 6+ hours/week pain with both founder verification and Gartner 2025 research corroboration across the SMB segment.
Clear competitive gap — no incumbent tool handles multi-processor CSV reconciliation end-to-end for small SaaS teams.
Weekly reconciliation cadence confirmed by founder and research — strong engagement signal and natural retention driver.
Chronic but not acute pain — no forcing event, deadline, or compliance driver accelerates purchasing urgency.
No structural moat — incumbents could close the gap with a feature sprint; no network effects or data flywheel confirmed.
Automated reconciliation is discretionary — no regulatory or audit mandate forces teams to solve this with a paid tool.
